locations.description: 一条狭窄隧道通向树桩深处，前方可见一轮奶酪。
locations.name: 入口隧道
locations.truth: 大石机关的诱饵为一轮奶酪，价值100p。触发伤害d12。先询问调查方法，再裁定触发。

locations.description: 石板门阻挡着前进的道路，门上留有可转动的把手。
locations.name: 主门
locations.truth: 转动把手会触发倾倒机关。d20伤害，DEX豁免成功减半。门和机关分开记录。

locations.description: 庭院中央有池塘，梯子通往树桩上的房屋。
locations.name: 庭院
locations.truth: 池底有金叶鼠像600p，占4槽，另有140p钱袋。Jack位于08奶酪工厂。

locations.description: 房间被翻找过，生活用具散落各处。
locations.name: 洗劫屋
locations.truth: 首次搜查生成d6件铜锅盘，每件10p。数量必须持久化，重复访问不重掷。

clues.text: 图画记录了庭院旧日的节庆布置，其中出现一尊鼠像。
clues.title: 旧日节庆画

locations.description: 一间安静的旧屋，墙上保留着节庆的图画。
locations.name: 废弃屋
locations.truth: 节庆画可以提示雕像原来的位置。分享图画线索时只公开调查者已获得的内容。

locations.description: 黏密蛛网遮住了屋内的视线，深处传出微弱动静。
locations.name: 蛛网屋
locations.truth: 两只蜘蛛与被困村民Roquefort、Paneer。两名村民和两只蜘蛛分别记录，初始仅KP可见。

locations.description: 宽大的厅堂里堆放着桶与杂物，可以听见活动的声音。
locations.name: 大厅
locations.truth: 首次生成2d6只Dedratz。蛇笛在此，战利品抽取三次。桶后锁门通08。鼠帮数值与战利品表须终校。

locations.description: 屋内的器具显示这里曾经用于制作奶酪。
locations.name: 奶酪工厂
locations.truth: Jack、搅拌桨和滤布在此。与03以门和升降机相连，与07之间有锁门，铁门通09，屋顶货口通室外。特殊移动由KP裁定。

locations.description: 铁门分隔了前后的空间，深处传来轻微摩擦声。
locations.name: 蛇笼
locations.truth: 守卫蛇在此，蛇实例全局复用，随机遭遇不重复生成。原版对照数值STR12、DEX10、WIL10、HP12、护甲2、d8咬击。

clues.text: 进一步调查指向北方的一处据点。主持在确认获取条件后补充详情，树桩镇首轮在此收束。
clues.title: 北方据点的线索

locations.description: 洞窟里堆着熟成的奶酪，空气中满是浓郁气味。
locations.name: 熟成洞
locations.truth: Ernie在此熟睡，库存八轮奶酪，每轮100p。宝箱抽战利品两次。Ernie数值与出口线索正文待原版终校。

return rule('sv.travel.auto', {'actor', 'destination:actor'}, function(r, actor, destination)
  local session = r.call('sv.automation', actor)
  assert(r.number(session, 'phase') == 1, 'SV_SESSION_NOT_STARTED')
  assert(r.number(actor, 'approved') == 1 and r.number(actor, 'ready') == 1, 'SV_NOT_READY')
  assert(r.number(actor, 'incapacitated') == 0 and r.number(actor, 'str') > 0 and r.number(actor, 'dex') > 0 and r.number(actor, 'wil') > 0, 'SV_CANNOT_ACT')
  assert(r.matches(destination, 'sv.location') and r.read(destination).visibility == 'public', 'SV_LOCATION_NOT_PUBLIC')
  local current, target = r.number(actor, 'location'), r.number(destination, 'index')
  local allowed = false
  for _, id in ipairs(r.readData('game.json').locations[current].exits) do if id == target then allowed = true end end
  assert(allowed, 'SV_NOT_ADJACENT')
  local key = 'door' .. math.min(current, target) .. '_' .. math.max(current, target)
  assert(r.read(session).numbers[key] == 1, 'SV_DOOR_CLOSED')
  r.set(actor, 'location', target)
  return {location=target, automatic=true}
end, {dependencies={'sv.automation'}})

return rule('sv.automation', {'actor'}, function(r, actor)
  assert(r.matches(actor, 'sv.character'), 'SV_NOT_CHARACTER')
  local links = r.related(actor, 'source')
  assert(#links == 1 and r.matches(links[1], 'sv.session'), 'SV_NOT_SESSION')
  assert((r.read(links[1]).numbers.autoResolve or 1) == 1, 'SV_KP_RULING_REQUIRED')
  return links[1]
end, {mode='calculation', public=false})

return rule('sv.check.core', {'actor', 'attribute:text', 'mode:text'}, function(r, actor, attribute, mode)
  assert(r.matches(actor, 'sv.character'), 'SV_NOT_CHARACTER')
  assert(r.number(actor, 'approved') == 1, 'SV_NOT_APPROVED')
  assert(r.number(actor, 'ready') == 1, 'SV_NOT_READY')
  assert(r.number(actor, 'incapacitated') == 0 and r.number(actor, 'str') > 0 and r.number(actor, 'dex') > 0 and r.number(actor, 'wil') > 0, 'SV_CANNOT_ACT')
  assert(attribute == 'str' or attribute == 'dex' or attribute == 'wil', 'SV_ATTRIBUTE')
  assert(mode == 'normal' or mode == 'advantage' or mode == 'disadvantage', 'SV_CHECK_MODE')
  local links = r.related(actor, 'source')
  assert(#links == 1 and r.number(links[1], 'phase') == 1, 'SV_SESSION_NOT_STARTED')
  local layout = r.call('sv.layout', actor)
  if layout.overloaded or (layout.injured and (attribute == 'str' or attribute == 'dex')) then mode = 'disadvantage' end
  local first, second = r.roll(20), 0
  local rolled = first
  if mode ~= 'normal' then
    second = r.roll(20)
    if mode == 'advantage' then rolled = math.min(first, second) else rolled = math.max(first, second) end
  end
  local target = r.number(actor, attribute)
  local passed = rolled <= target
  r.set(actor, 'lastRoll', rolled)
  r.set(actor, 'checks', r.number(actor, 'checks') + 1)
  return {attribute=attribute, first=first, second=second, rolled=rolled, target=target, passed=passed, mode=mode}
end, {public=false, dependencies={'sv.layout'}})

return rule('sv.create', {'actor'}, function(r, actor)
  assert(r.matches(actor, 'sv.draft'), 'SV_NOT_DRAFT')
  local values = {}
  for _, key in ipairs({'str', 'dex', 'wil'}) do
    local a, b, c = r.roll(6), r.roll(6), r.roll(6)
    values[key] = a + b + c - math.min(a, math.min(b, c))
    r.set(actor, key, values[key])
  end
  values.hp, values.pips = r.roll(6), r.roll(6)
  r.set(actor, 'hp', values.hp)
  r.set(actor, 'pips', values.pips)
  r.set(actor, 'generation', r.number(actor, 'generation') + 1)
  return values
end)

return rule('sv.damage', {'actor', 'amount:amount', 'attribute:text'}, function(r, actor, amount, attribute)
  assert(r.matches(actor, 'sv.character') or (r.matches(actor, 'sv.npc') or r.number(actor, 'isNpc') == 1), 'SV_DAMAGE_TARGET')
  assert(attribute == 'str' or attribute == 'dex', 'SV_DAMAGE_ATTRIBUTE')
  assert(amount <= 1000, 'SV_DAMAGE_RANGE')
  local layout = nil
  if r.matches(actor, 'sv.character') then layout = r.call('sv.layout', actor) end
  local armor = math.max(r.number(actor, 'armor'), layout and layout.armor or 0)
  local damage = math.max(0, amount - armor)
  local oldHp = r.number(actor, 'hp')
  local hp = math.max(0, oldHp - damage)
  local overflow = math.max(0, damage - oldHp)
  r.set(actor, 'hp', hp)
  local target = r.number(actor, attribute)
  local rolled, critical = 0, false
  if overflow > 0 then
    target = math.max(0, target - overflow)
    r.set(actor, attribute, target)
    rolled = r.roll(20)
    critical = rolled > target
    if critical then
      r.set(actor, 'incapacitated', 1)
      if layout then
        local placed = false
        for slot=1,20 do
          if not placed and not layout.occupied[tostring(slot)] then
            r.set(actor, 'item' .. slot, 12)
            r.set(actor, 'uses' .. slot, 0)
            r.set(actor, 'ticks' .. slot, 0)
            placed = true
          end
        end
        if not placed then r.set(actor, 'conditionPending', r.number(actor, 'conditionPending') + 1) end
      end
    end
  end
  return {damage=damage, hp=hp, overflow=overflow, attribute=attribute, remaining=target, save=rolled, critical=critical, dead=attribute=='str' and target==0}
end, {kp=true, dependencies={'sv.layout'}})

return rule('sv.generate', {'actor', 'kind:text'}, function(r, actor, kind)
  assert(r.matches(actor, 'sv.world'), 'SV_NOT_WORLD')
  local results = {}
  if kind == 'character' then
    for _, key in ipairs({'str', 'dex', 'wil'}) do
      local a, b, c = r.roll(6), r.roll(6), r.roll(6)
      results[key] = a + b + c - math.min(a, math.min(b, c))
    end
    results.hp = r.roll(6)
    results.pips = r.roll(6)
  elseif kind == 'pots' then
    assert(r.number(actor, 'generated4') == 0, 'SV_ALREADY_GENERATED')
    results.count = r.roll(6)
    r.set(actor, 'pots', results.count)
    r.set(actor, 'generated4', 1)
  elseif kind == 'rats' then
    assert(r.number(actor, 'generated7') == 0, 'SV_ALREADY_GENERATED')
    results.count = r.roll(6) + r.roll(6)
    r.set(actor, 'rats', results.count)
    r.set(actor, 'generated7', 1)
  elseif kind == 'encounter' or kind == 'encounter-table' then
    results.rolled = r.roll(6)
  elseif kind == 'reaction' then
    results.first = r.roll(6)
    results.second = r.roll(6)
    results.total = results.first + results.second
  elseif kind == 'loot' then
    results.rolled = r.roll(20)
  else error('SV_GENERATE_KIND') end
  return results
end, {kp=true})

return rule('sv.grant', {'actor', 'item:amount', 'slot:amount', 'uses:amount'}, function(r, actor, item, slot, uses)
  assert(r.matches(actor, 'sv.character'), 'SV_NOT_CHARACTER')
  assert(slot >= 1 and slot <= 20, 'SV_SLOT')

  r.set(actor, 'uses' .. slot, uses)
  r.set(actor, 'ticks' .. slot, 0)

  return {item=item, slot=slot, overloaded=layout.overloaded}
end, {kp=true, dependencies={'sv.layout'}})

return rule('sv.inventory.core', {'actor', 'operation:text', 'slot:amount', 'value:amount'}, function(r, actor, operation, slot, value)
  assert(r.matches(actor, 'sv.character'), 'SV_NOT_CHARACTER')
  assert(slot >= 1 and slot <= 20, 'SV_SLOT')
  local data = r.readData('game.json')
  local index = r.number(actor, 'item' .. slot)
  assert(index > 0 and data.items[index], 'SV_EMPTY_SLOT')
  local def = data.items[index]
  if operation == 'move' then
    assert(value >= 1 and value <= 20 and value ~= slot, 'SV_TARGET_SLOT')
    assert(r.number(actor, 'item' .. value) == 0, 'SV_SLOT_OCCUPIED')
    local uses = r.number(actor, 'uses' .. slot)
    local ticks = r.number(actor, 'ticks' .. slot)
    r.set(actor, 'item' .. slot, 0)
    r.set(actor, 'uses' .. slot, 0)
    r.set(actor, 'ticks' .. slot, 0)
    r.set(actor, 'item' .. value, index)
    r.set(actor, 'uses' .. value, uses)
    r.set(actor, 'ticks' .. value, ticks)
    if r.number(actor, 'litSlot') == slot then r.set(actor, 'litSlot', value) end
  elseif operation == 'use' then
    assert(def.uses > 0 and def.kind ~= 'condition' and def.kind ~= 'spell', 'SV_ITEM_NO_USES_OR_MANUAL_SPELL')
    local uses = r.number(actor, 'uses' .. slot)
    assert(uses > 0, 'SV_ITEM_EXHAUSTED')
    local consumed = 1
    if def.useDie then consumed = r.roll(6) >= 4 and 1 or 0 end
    r.set(actor, 'uses' .. slot, uses - consumed)
    if uses - consumed == 0 and r.number(actor, 'litSlot') == slot then r.set(actor, 'litSlot', 0) end
  elseif operation == 'light' then
    assert(def.light == true and r.number(actor, 'uses' .. slot) > 0, 'SV_NOT_LIGHT_SOURCE')
    r.set(actor, 'litSlot', slot)
  elseif operation == 'extinguish' then
    assert(r.number(actor, 'litSlot') == slot, 'SV_NOT_LIT')
    r.set(actor, 'litSlot', 0)
  else
    error('SV_INVENTORY_OPERATION')
  end
  local layout = r.call('sv.layout', actor)
  return {operation=operation, slot=slot, target=value, uses=r.number(actor, 'uses' .. slot), overloaded=layout.overloaded}
end, {public=false, dependencies={'sv.layout'}})
sources.layout.lua:
return rule('sv.layout', {'actor'}, function(r, actor)
  local data = r.readData('game.json')
  -- Numeric indices are persistent inventory/location identities.
  for index, place in ipairs(data.locations) do
    assert(place.index == index, 'SV_LOCATION_INDEX')
    for _, target in ipairs(place.exits) do
      assert(target ~= index and data.locations[target], 'SV_LOCATION_EXIT')
    end
    for _, stock in ipairs(place.stock) do
      assert(data.items[stock.item] and stock.count >= 0, 'SV_LOCATION_STOCK')
    end
  end
  local occupied, cards = {}, {}
  local overloaded, armor, injured = false, 0, false
  for slot = 1, 20 do
    local index = r.number(actor, 'item' .. slot)
    if index > 0 then
      local def = data.items[index]
      assert(def, 'SV_UNKNOWN_ITEM')
      local cells = {slot}
      if def.id == 'injured' then injured = true end
      if slot > 10 then
        overloaded = true
      elseif def.slots == 2 then
        if def.shape == 'offhand-body' and slot <= 4 then
          assert(slot == 2, 'SV_LIGHT_ARMOR_OFFHAND_BODY')
          cells = {2, 3}
        elseif slot <= 4 then
          assert(slot == 1 or slot == 3, 'SV_ITEM_NEEDS_TWO_SLOTS')
          cells = {slot, slot + 1}
        else
          assert(slot == 5 or slot == 6 or slot == 8 or slot == 9, 'SV_ITEM_NEEDS_TWO_SLOTS')
          cells = {slot, slot + 1}
        end
      elseif def.slots == 4 then
        assert(slot == 5 or slot == 6, 'SV_ITEM_NEEDS_FOUR_SLOTS')
        cells = {slot, slot + 1, slot + 3, slot + 4}
      end
      if def.kind == 'armor' and slot <= 4 and r.number(actor, 'uses' .. slot) > 0 then armor = math.max(armor, def.armor or 0) end
      for _, cell in ipairs(cells) do
        assert(not occupied[tostring(cell)], 'SV_SLOT_OCCUPIED')
        occupied[tostring(cell)] = slot
      end
      cards[#cards + 1] = {slot=slot, item=index, uses=r.number(actor, 'uses' .. slot), cells=cells}
    end
  end
  local coins = math.ceil(math.max(0, r.number(actor, 'pips') - 250) / 250)
  local coinSlots = {}
  for slot=10,1,-1 do
    if coins > 0 and not occupied[tostring(slot)] then
      occupied[tostring(slot)] = -1
      coinSlots[#coinSlots+1] = slot
      coins = coins - 1
    end
  end
  if coins > 0 then overloaded = true end
  return {occupied=occupied, cards=cards, overloaded=overloaded, armor=armor, injured=injured, coinSlots=coinSlots}
end, {mode='calculation', public=false})

return rule('sv.profile', {'actor', 'strength:amount', 'dexterity:amount', 'will:amount', 'hp:amount', 'pips:amount'}, function(r, actor, strength, dexterity, will, hp, pips)
  assert(r.matches(actor, 'sv.character'), 'SV_NOT_CHARACTER')
  assert(r.number(actor, 'approved') == 0, 'SV_PROFILE_LOCKED')
  assert(strength >= 2 and strength <= 12 and dexterity >= 2 and dexterity <= 12 and will >= 2 and will <= 12, 'SV_START_ATTRIBUTE_RANGE')
  assert(hp >= 1 and hp <= 6 and pips <= 6, 'SV_START_RESOURCE_RANGE')
  r.set(actor, 'str', strength)
  r.set(actor, 'strMax', strength)
  r.set(actor, 'dex', dexterity)
  r.set(actor, 'dexMax', dexterity)
  r.set(actor, 'wil', will)
  r.set(actor, 'wilMax', will)
  r.set(actor, 'maxHp', hp)
  r.set(actor, 'hp', hp)
  r.set(actor, 'pips', pips)
  r.set(actor, 'approved', 1)
  return {character=actor, approved=true}
end, {kp=true})
sources.rest.lua:
return rule('sv.rest', {'actor', 'kind:text', 'attribute:text'}, function(r, actor, kind, attribute)
  assert(r.matches(actor, 'sv.character'), 'SV_NOT_CHARACTER')
  assert(r.number(actor, 'str') > 0, 'SV_DEAD_CANNOT_REST')
  if kind == 'short' then
    local healing = r.roll(6) + 1
    r.set(actor, 'hp', math.min(r.number(actor, 'maxHp'), r.number(actor, 'hp') + healing))
    r.set(actor, 'incapacitated', 0)
  elseif kind == 'long' then
    assert(attribute == 'str' or attribute == 'dex' or attribute == 'wil', 'SV_ATTRIBUTE')
    local full = r.number(actor, 'hp') == r.number(actor, 'maxHp')
    r.set(actor, 'hp', r.number(actor, 'maxHp'))
    if full then
      r.set(actor, attribute, math.min(r.number(actor, attribute .. 'Max'), r.number(actor, attribute) + r.roll(6)))
    end
  elseif kind == 'full' then
    r.set(actor, 'hp', r.number(actor, 'maxHp'))
    for _, key in ipairs({'str', 'dex', 'wil'}) do r.set(actor, key, r.number(actor, key .. 'Max')) end
    r.set(actor, 'incapacitated', 0)
    r.set(actor, 'conditionPending', 0)
  else error('SV_REST_KIND') end
  local items = r.readData('game.json').items
  for slot=1,20 do
    local item = items[r.number(actor, 'item' .. slot)]
    if item and item.kind == 'condition' and (kind == 'full' or item.id == 'frightened' or (kind == 'long' and item.id == 'exhausted')) then
      r.set(actor, 'item' .. slot, 0)
      r.set(actor, 'uses' .. slot, 0)
      r.set(actor, 'ticks' .. slot, 0)
    end
  end
  return {kind=kind, hp=r.number(actor, 'hp')}
end, {kp=true})

-- Host transaction for a validated, finite scene recipe. Never public to PL.
return rule('sv.scene.resolve', {'actor', 'scene:actor', 'world:actor', 'action:text', 'choice:text'}, function(r, actor, scene, world, action, choice)
  assert(r.matches(actor,'sv.character') and r.matches(scene,'sv.scene') and r.matches(world,'sv.world'),'SV_SCENE_TARGET')
  assert(r.number(actor,'approved')==1 and r.number(actor,'ready')==1,'SV_NOT_READY')
  assert(r.number(actor,'incapacitated')==0 and r.number(actor,'str')>0 and r.number(actor,'dex')>0 and r.number(actor,'wil')>0,'SV_CANNOT_ACT')
  local session=r.related(actor,'source')[1]
  assert(session and r.number(session,'phase')==1,'SV_SESSION_NOT_STARTED')
  local spec=nil
  for _,a in ipairs(r.readData('scene-actions.json').actions) do if a.id==action then spec=a end end
  assert(spec and r.number(actor,'location')==spec.location,'SV_SCENE_LOCATION')
  local valid=false
  for _,c in ipairs(spec.choices) do if c.id==choice then valid=true end end
  assert(valid,'SV_SCENE_CHOICE')
  local game=r.readData('game.json')
  local out={title=spec.label,sceneAction=action,choice=choice,narrative={},checks={},rolls={},stateChanges={},clues={},outcome='success',cost=0}
  local reveal,doors={},{}
  local function say(s) out.narrative[#out.narrative+1]=s end
  local function get(k) return r.number(scene,k) end
  local function set(k,v,label)
    local old=get(k)
    if old~=v then r.set(scene,k,v);out.stateChanges[#out.stateChanges+1]={key=k,label=label,before=old,after=v} end
  end
  local function fail(s) out.outcome='blocked';say(s) end
  local function clue(id,title,text)
    out.clues[#out.clues+1]={id=id,title=title,text=text,location=spec.location}
  end
  local function dice(sides,label)
    local v=r.roll(sides);out.rolls[#out.rolls+1]={sides=sides,value=v,label=label};return v
  end
  local function check(attribute,label)
    local layout=r.call('sv.layout',actor)
    local mode=(layout.overloaded or (layout.injured and (attribute=='str' or attribute=='dex'))) and 'disadvantage' or 'normal'
    local first=r.roll(20);local second=mode=='disadvantage' and r.roll(20) or 0
    local rolled=math.max(first,second);local target=r.number(actor,attribute)
    local passed=rolled<=target
    out.checks[#out.checks+1]={attribute=attribute,first=first,second=second,rolled=rolled,target=target,passed=passed,mode=mode,label=label}
    r.set(actor,'checks',r.number(actor,'checks')+1);r.set(actor,'lastRoll',rolled)
    if not passed then out.outcome='failure' end
    return passed
  end
  local function hurt(amount,attribute)
    local result=r.call('sv.damage',actor,amount,attribute or 'str')
    out.damage=result
    if result.save>0 then out.checks[#out.checks+1]={attribute=result.attribute,first=result.save,second=0,rolled=result.save,target=result.remaining,passed=not result.critical,mode='normal',label='重伤豁免'} end
    say('扣除护甲后受到 '..result.damage..' 点伤害，HP 剩余 '..result.hp..'。')
    if result.critical then say('角色已失能，需要恢复后才能继续行动。') end
    if result.dead then say('STR 已降至 0。') end
  end
  local function has(item)
    for i=1,20 do if r.number(actor,'item'..i)==item and (game.items[item].uses==0 or r.number(actor,'uses'..i)>0) then return i end end
    return nil
  end
  local function free_slot(item)
    local layout=r.call('sv.layout',actor);local def=game.items[item]
    for s=1,20 do
      local cells={s};local ok=true
      if s<=10 and def.slots==2 then
        if def.shape=='offhand-body' and s<=4 then ok=s==2;cells={2,3}
        elseif s<=4 then ok=s==1 or s==3;cells={s,s+1}
        else ok=s==5 or s==6 or s==8 or s==9;cells={s,s+1} end
      elseif s<=10 and def.slots==4 then ok=s==5 or s==6;cells={s,s+1,s+3,s+4} end
      for _,c in ipairs(cells) do if layout.occupied[tostring(c)] then ok=false end end
      if ok then return s end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function take(item,key,label)
    if get(key)<=0 then fail('这里已经没有可领取的'..game.items[item].name..'。');return false end
    local slot=free_slot(item)
    if not slot then fail('所有槽位均已占用，物品仍留在原处；整理背包后可再取。');return false end
    r.call('sv.grant',actor,item,slot,game.items[item].uses)
    set(key,get(key)-1,label)
    say('获得'..game.items[item].name..'，放入槽位 '..slot..(slot>10 and '（超载区）。' or '。'))
    return true
  end
  local function consume(item,label)
    local slot=has(item)
    if not slot then fail('需要一件仍有用量的'..game.items[item].name..'。');return false end
    r.set(actor,'uses'..slot,r.number(actor,'uses'..slot)-1)
    say(label..'，消耗槽位 '..slot..' 的一格用量。');return true
  end
  local function discover_ground()
    set('trapKnown',1,'入口机关已识别')
    clue('tunnel-trap','入口地面的压痕','地面有落石留下的压痕，奶酪连接着触发装置；直接取走会有危险。')
    reveal={2}
  end
  local function rats()
    if r.number(world,'generated7')==0 then
      local n=dice(6,'鼠帮人数')+dice(6,'鼠帮人数')
      r.set(world,'rats',n);r.set(world,'generated7',1)
    end
    set('ratsObserved',1,'鼠帮已观察')
    say('厅堂里有 '..r.number(world,'rats')..' 只鼠帮成员；桶后有一道锁门，杂物旁放着蛇笛。')
  end
  local function deal()
    set('ratsDeal',1,'已取得鼠帮通行许可');set('hallDoor',1,'大厅后门已开放')
    doors={{edge='7-8',status='open'}};reveal={8}
    say('鼠帮同意放行，并用蛇笛完成这次交换。')
    if get('fluteRemaining')>0 then take(9,'fluteRemaining','蛇笛剩余数量') end
  end

  if action=='tunnel-ground' then
    discover_ground();say('你避开压痕，辨认出奶酪与上方落石的连接，并找到了通往主门的路线。')
  elseif action=='tunnel-cheese' then
    if choice=='inspect' then
      discover_ground();say('奶酪是机关诱饵。现在已经记录连接的位置，检查本身不会触发机关。')
    elseif get('cheese1')==0 then fail('奶酪已经被取走。')
    elseif not free_slot(6) then fail('背包没有可用槽位，奶酪留在原处。')
    elseif choice=='careful' and get('trapKnown')==0 then fail('先检查奶酪周围或观察地面，确认连接后才能拆解。')
    else
      out.cost=1;reveal={2}
      if get('trapState')==0 then
        if choice=='careful' and check('dex','解除奶酪的机关连接') then
          set('trapState',1,'入口机关（0待处理/1解除/2触发）');say('连接被稳妥解除，落石没有落下。')
        else
          set('trapState',2,'入口机关（0待处理/1解除/2触发）');hurt(dice(12,'入口落石伤害'))
          say('落石已经落下，机关不会再次触发。')
          if choice=='careful' or r.number(actor,'incapacitated')==1 or r.number(actor,'str')==0 then say('奶酪暂留原地。') end
        end
      else say('入口机关已经失效，可以安全取走奶酪。') end
      if out.outcome~='failure' and r.number(actor,'incapacitated')==0 and r.number(actor,'str')>0 then take(6,'cheese1','入口奶酪剩余数量') end
    end
  elseif action=='gate-handle' then
    set('gateKnown',1,'主门结构已识别');say('转动把手会使石板倾倒。门框上有可以绑绳固定的位置。')
    clue('gate-trap','倾倒的石板门','用绳索固定后再转动把手可避开倾倒；直接开启则需要躲避石板。')
  elseif action=='gate-open' then
    if get('gateOpen')==1 then say('石板门已经打开，可以前往庭院。');reveal={3}
    elseif choice=='brace' and get('gateKnown')==0 then fail('先检查把手和门框，确定固定位置。')
    elseif choice=='brace' and not has(4) then fail('需要仍有用量的绳索固定石板；也可以另选直接开门。')
    else
      out.cost=1
      if choice=='brace' then consume(4,'固定石板');set('gateTrap',1,'石板机关（0待处理/1解除/2触发）')
      elseif get('gateTrap')==0 then
        local avoided=check('dex','躲避倾倒石板');local amount=dice(20,'石板伤害')
        if avoided then amount=math.floor(amount/2);say('豁免成功，石板伤害减半。') end
        set('gateTrap',2,'石板机关（0待处理/1解除/2触发）');hurt(amount)
      end
      set('gateOpen',1,'石板门已打开');doors={{edge='2-3',status='open'}};reveal={3}
      say('石板门已经打开，庭院及其通路出现在已知地图上。')
    end
  elseif action=='courtyard-pool' then
    if choice=='inspect' then
      set('poolKnown',1,'池底宝物已发现');say('水下有一尊金叶鼠像和一只钱袋。鼠像占四格，钱袋内共有 140p。')
      clue('pool-treasure','池底的宝物','池底有四格金叶鼠像与钱袋；领取以现场剩余库存为准。')
    elseif get('poolKnown')==0 then fail('先查看池底，确定打捞目标。')
    elseif (choice=='money' and get('moneyRemaining')==0) or (choice=='idol' and get('idolRemaining')==0) then fail('这件宝物已经被取走。')
    elseif choice=='idol' and not free_slot(7) then fail('无法安置鼠像，宝物仍在池底。')
    else
      out.cost=1
      if check('dex','潜入池底打捞') then
        if choice=='money' then
          local amount=get('moneyRemaining');r.set(actor,'pips',r.number(actor,'pips')+amount);set('moneyRemaining',0,'池底剩余钱币');say('取得钱袋，钱币增加 '..amount..'p。')
        else take(7,'idolRemaining','池底鼠像剩余数量') end
      else hurt(dice(4,'潜水磕碰伤害'));say('你被水流推回岸边，宝物仍留在池底。') end
    end
  elseif action=='courtyard-ladders' then
    set('laddersKnown',1,'庭院路线已辨认');reveal={4,5,6,7,8};say('梯子通往三间房屋，地面通路连接大厅和奶酪工厂；这些地点已加入地图。')
  elseif action=='house-pots' then
    if r.number(world,'generated4')==0 then
      local count=dice(6,'首次搜查器具数量');r.set(world,'generated4',1);r.set(world,'pots',count);set('potsRemaining',count,'剩余铜锅盘');out.cost=1
    end
    set('potsKnown',1,'器具已整理');say('现场剩余 '..get('potsRemaining')..' 件铜锅盘，每件价值 10p。')
    if choice=='take' then take(8,'potsRemaining','剩余铜锅盘') end
  elseif action=='house-painting' then
    set('paintingRead',1,'节庆画已阅读');say('旧画描绘了庭院中央的一尊金色鼠像，与池底的物件相符。')
    clue('festival','旧日节庆画','旧画记录了庭院节庆时的布置，池底鼠像原本是庭院的陈设。')
  elseif action=='web-inspect' then
    set('webKnown',1,'蛛网屋危险已识别');say('两只蜘蛛在网线深处活动，网后困着两名村民。保持距离观察没有惊动它们。')
    clue('web-captives','蛛网后的村民','网线后困着 Roquefort 和 Paneer；携带可用武器可以尝试割断束缚。')
  elseif action=='web-call' then
    if choice=='whisper' then
      set('villagersContacted',1,'已联系被困村民');say('Roquefort 和 Paneer 低声回应，指出可以割断的网线。')
      clue('villager-reply','被困者的回应','两名村民尚能行动，束缚他们的网线可以割断，但附近有蜘蛛。')
    elseif get('villagersFreed')==1 then say('两名村民已经脱困，正在安全的庭院等待。')
    elseif not has(1) then fail('需要仍有用量的针剑才能执行这个固定救援做法。')
    else
      out.cost=1
      if check('dex','避开网线割断束缚') then
        set('villagersFreed',1,'两名村民已脱困');say('束缚被割开，两名村民沿梯子撤到庭院。')
        clue('villagers-rescued','Roquefort 与 Paneer 已脱困','你完成了救援，两名村民已撤到庭院。')
      else set('spidersAlert',1,'蜘蛛已警觉');hurt(dice(6,'蜘蛛毒咬伤害'),'dex');say('网线惊动了蜘蛛，救援尚未完成。') end
    end
  elseif action=='hall-observe' then rats()
  elseif action=='hall-negotiate' then
    rats()
    if get('ratsDeal')==1 then say('鼠帮仍认可之前的通行约定。');if get('fluteRemaining')>0 then take(9,'fluteRemaining','蛇笛剩余数量') end
    elseif choice=='food' then if consume(3,'提供口粮') then out.cost=1;deal() end
    elseif get('ratsTalked')==1 then fail('鼠帮已经拒绝这番说辞；可选择提供口粮，不会重复掷骰刷取结果。')
    else
      out.cost=1;set('ratsTalked',1,'已尝试口头交涉')
      if check('wil','说服鼠帮允许通行') then deal()
      else set('ratsAlert',1,'鼠帮保持戒备');say('鼠帮拒绝放行，但愿意用食物交换；后门仍锁住，蛇笛未取得。') end
    end
  elseif action=='factory-equipment' then
    if choice=='inspect' then
      set('factoryKnown',1,'工厂设备已检查');say('Jack 介绍了搅拌桨、滤布与升降机，并允许你取用留下的工具。')
      clue('factory-tools','工厂器具与升降机','工厂有有限数量的搅拌桨、滤布；升降机可以返回庭院。')
    elseif get('factoryKnown')==0 then fail('先检查设备并询问 Jack。')
    elseif choice=='paddle' then take(10,'paddleRemaining','剩余搅拌桨')
    else take(11,'clothRemaining','剩余滤布') end
  elseif action=='factory-exits' then
    if choice=='survey' then
      set('roofKnown',1,'工厂出口已辨认');reveal={3,7,9};say('你找到升降机、通往蛇笼的铁门和屋顶货口；桶后通往大厅的门仍遵循其锁闭状态。')
      clue('factory-exits','工厂出口','升降机通庭院，铁门通蛇笼，屋顶有通往室外的货口。')
    elseif choice=='iron' then
      if get('ironOpen')==0 then out.cost=1 end
      set('ironOpen',1,'工厂铁门已打开');doors={{edge='8-9',status='open'}};reveal={9};say('通往蛇笼的铁门已开放。')
    else r.set(actor,'location',3);reveal={3};say('你乘升降机返回庭院。');out.cost=1 end
  elseif action=='cage-gate' then
    set('snakeKnown',1,'守卫蛇已发现')
    if choice=='inspect' then say('洞窟在另一道铁门后。守卫蛇盘踞在门前，接近门闩需要先安抚它或冒险绕过。')
    elseif get('snakeCalmed')==0 then fail('守卫蛇尚未平静；可用蛇笛安抚，或从“聆听”选择潜行绕过。')
    else set('caveOpen',1,'洞窟铁门已开放');doors={{edge='9-10',status='open'}};reveal={10};say('你从平静的守卫蛇旁经过，打开了洞窟铁门。') end
  elseif action=='cage-listen' then
    set('snakeKnown',1,'守卫蛇已发现')
    if choice=='listen' then
      say('呼吸声与鳞片摩擦声来自同一条守卫蛇。它仍在门边，没有生成新的蛇。')
      clue('snake-rhythm','守卫蛇的动静','可以用蛇笛安抚守卫，或冒险绕过它开启洞窟铁门。')
    elseif choice=='flute' then
      if not has(9) then fail('需要携带蛇笛；可返回大厅交涉获取。')
      else set('snakeCalmed',1,'守卫蛇已平静');say('笛声让守卫蛇放松下来，现在可以靠近铁门。');out.cost=1 end
    else
      out.cost=1
      if get('caveOpen')==1 then say('通向洞窟的门已经打开。');out.cost=0
      elseif check('dex','绕过守卫蛇开启铁门') then
        set('caveOpen',1,'洞窟铁门已开放');doors={{edge='9-10',status='open'}};reveal={10};say('你抓住间隙拉开门闩，通路已经开放。')
      else set('snakeAlert',1,'守卫蛇已警觉');hurt(dice(8,'守卫蛇咬击伤害'));say('守卫蛇拦住去路，铁门仍未开启。') end
    end
  elseif action=='cave-cheese' then
    if choice=='inspect' then set('agingKnown',1,'奶酪库存已清点');say('这里还剩 '..get('cheese10')..' 轮奶酪，每轮价值 100p。')
    elseif get('cheese10')==0 then fail('这里的奶酪已取完。')
    elseif not free_slot(6) then fail('没有可用槽位，奶酪仍在原处。')
    elseif get('ernieAwake')==1 and get('ernieSpoken')==0 then fail('Ernie 已经醒来，先与他交谈取得许可。')
    else
      out.cost=1
      if get('ernieSpoken')==1 or check('dex','不惊动睡者取走奶酪') then take(6,'cheese10','熟成洞剩余奶酪')
      else set('ernieAwake',1,'Ernie 已醒来');say('动静惊醒了 Ernie，你停下动作，奶酪数量没有减少。') end
    end
  elseif action=='cave-sleeper' then
    set('ernieKnown',1,'Ernie 已被辨认')
    if choice=='observe' then say(get('ernieAwake')==1 and 'Ernie 已醒来，正看着洞中的动静。' or 'Ernie 正在熟睡。贸然搬动奶酪可能惊醒他。')
    else
      if get('ernieSpoken')==0 then out.cost=1 end
      set('ernieAwake',1,'Ernie 已醒来');set('ernieSpoken',1,'已与 Ernie 交谈');set('northKnown',1,'北方线索已取得')
      say('Ernie 允许你取用这里的奶酪，并指出失踪者的后续去向在北方。线索已加入记录。')
      clue('north','北方据点的线索','交谈得知，后续调查应前往北方的一处据点。树桩镇这一阶段的追踪线索已取得。')
    end
  end
  if out.cost>0 then
    local next=r.call('sv.world',session,'round',r.number(session,'round'))
    out.round=next.round;out.encounterDue=next.encounterDue
    say('经过一个探索轮，现在是第 '..next.round..' 回合；光源用量按已有规则结算。')
  end
  if #out.checks==0 and #out.rolls==0 then out.process='本做法不需要投骰，按现场条件直接判定。' else out.process='宿主已完成以下投骰与判定。' end
  return {public=out,reveals=reveal,doors=doors,sceneState=r.read(scene).numbers}
end, {kp=true,dependencies={'sv.layout','sv.damage','sv.grant','sv.world'}})
sources.transfer.lua:
return rule('sv.transfer', {'actor', 'target:actor', 'slot:amount', 'destination:amount'}, function(r, actor, target, slot, destination)
  assert(actor ~= target and r.matches(actor, 'sv.character') and r.matches(target, 'sv.character'), 'SV_TRANSFER_TARGET')
  assert(slot >= 1 and slot <= 20 and destination >= 1 and destination <= 20, 'SV_SLOT')
  local item = r.number(actor, 'item' .. slot)
  assert(item > 0 and r.number(target, 'item' .. destination) == 0, 'SV_SLOT_OCCUPIED')
  for _, prefix in ipairs({'item', 'uses', 'ticks'}) do
    r.set(target, prefix .. destination, r.number(actor, prefix .. slot))
    r.set(actor, prefix .. slot, 0)
  end
  if r.number(actor, 'litSlot') == slot then r.set(actor, 'litSlot', 0) end
  r.call('sv.layout', actor)
  local layout = r.call('sv.layout', target)
  return {item=item, recipient=target, slot=destination, overloaded=layout.overloaded}
end, {kp=true, dependencies={'sv.layout'}})
sources.world.lua:
return rule('sv.world', {'actor', 'operation:text', 'value:amount'}, function(r, actor, operation, value)
  assert(r.matches(actor, 'sv.session'), 'SV_NOT_SESSION')
  if operation == 'start' then
    r.set(actor, 'phase', 1)
  elseif operation == 'round' then
    assert(r.number(actor, 'phase') == 1, 'SV_SESSION_NOT_STARTED')
    assert(value == r.number(actor, 'round'), 'SV_ROUND_CONFLICT')
    local characters = r.related(actor, 'references')
    local lights = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(characters) do
      if r.matches(id, 'sv.character') then
        local slot = r.number(id, 'litSlot')
        if slot > 0 then
          local ticks = r.number(id, 'ticks' .. slot) + 1
          if ticks >= 6 then
            local uses = math.max(0, r.number(id, 'uses' .. slot) - 1)
            r.set(id, 'uses' .. slot, uses)
            ticks = 0
            if uses == 0 then r.set(id, 'litSlot', 0) end
            lights[#lights + 1] = {actor=id, slot=slot, uses=uses}
          end
          r.set(id, 'ticks' .. slot, ticks)
        end
      end
    end
    r.set(actor, 'round', value + 1)
    return {round=value + 1, lights=lights, encounterDue=(value + 1)%3==0}
  elseif operation == 'finish' then
    r.set(actor, 'phase', 2)
  else error('SV_WORLD_OPERATION') end
  return {phase=r.number(actor, 'phase'), round=r.number(actor, 'round')}
end, {kp=true})
